Creature Catch Field Guide

Every creature from Home Village to the Hollow Deep, place by place in the order you'll meet them: where to find them, how they grow, and the stories the old folks tell about them.

CreaturesMapTypesCubes & items

Creatures

This guide follows your journey. Each tab is one place, in the order you reach it, and the creatures are numbered the same way as the Creature Log in the game. Open a place's tab once you get there, so nothing is spoiled. Creatures hide in tall grass: weaken one, throw a cube, and it's yours.

Types

Eight elemental types go round in a wheel. Each one hits two others for double damage and is hit hard by two others. Normal sits outside the wheel and is even with everything. Read across from the attacking type, then down to the defender.

2 = double damage½ = half damageblank = normal damageA creature with two types multiplies both, so 4x and ¼x can happen.

Map

The land is one long road from Home Village to the Night Ruins, with Copperbell Town halfway along. Each place's wild creatures are a little stronger than the last, and a guide at each exit opens the way forward once you beat their trial. Every region has an outpost with a Healing Hut and the Cube Vault. Side paths lead off the road to orchards, coves, springs and old ruins, and some creatures only come out by day or at night.

Cubes & items

Every capture cube is purple on top and blue on the bottom. Better cubes add bands and studs, and better odds. A creature that is worn down, asleep, or frozen is much easier to catch.

Creature Catch Field Guide, made from the game's own data (v10). Pictures marked "art coming" are still being painted.
